name: ChatGPT Atlas
desc: ChatGPT Atlas is OpenAI's web browser with ChatGPT built in, including an agent mode that can browse and act on pages for you. Free to use with a ChatGPT account; agent features need a paid plan.

name: Perplexity Comet
desc: Comet is Perplexity's agentic browser that turns search into answers and can carry out multi-step tasks across tabs. Free tier available, with more agent usage on Pro/Max.

name: Nano Banana
desc: Nano Banana is the nickname for Google's Gemini native image generation and editing model, known for strong character consistency and conversational edits. Available in the Gemini app and via API.

name: Seedream
desc: Seedream is ByteDance's high-resolution text-to-image and image-editing model with strong bilingual (English/Chinese) text rendering, offered through Volcengine and partner APIs.

name: Seedance
desc: Seedance is ByteDance's video generation model producing multi-shot, motion-consistent clips from text or images, available via Volcengine and aggregator APIs.

name: MiniMax
desc: MiniMax builds frontier LLMs (incl. open-weight MiniMax-M models), plus the MiniMax Agent and Hailuo media tools, available through chat apps and a unified API.

name: Opus Clip
tagline: Long video into viral short clips.
desc: Opus Clip uses AI to cut long-form videos and podcasts into ranked short clips with captions and reframing for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. Free tier with watermarked exports.

name: PlayAI
desc: PlayAI (formerly PlayHT) offers natural text-to-speech, voice cloning, and conversational voice agents via a developer API, with a free starter tier.

name: Fish Audio
desc: Fish Audio provides multilingual text-to-speech and instant voice cloning, backed by open-weight models (OpenAudio/Fish-Speech) and a hosted API with a free tier.

name: Supermaven
desc: Supermaven is a low-latency AI code completion plugin with a very large context window across major editors. Free tier available; the team joined Cursor.

name: Raycast AI
desc: Raycast AI brings chat, quick AI commands, and multiple frontier models into the Raycast launcher for macOS and Windows, with a free tier and paid Pro models.

name: Mem0
desc: Mem0 is an open-source memory layer that gives LLM apps and agents persistent, personalized long-term memory, available self-hosted or as a managed platform.

name: Letta
desc: Letta (from the MemGPT team) is an open-source framework and cloud for building stateful agents that retain memory across sessions, with an Agent Development Environment.

name: AutoGen
desc: AutoGen is Microsoft's open-source framework for building multi-agent applications where LLM agents collaborate and use tools to solve tasks. Free and open source.

name: Abacus AI
desc: Abacus AI offers an enterprise platform for building AI agents and ML systems, plus ChatLLM/DeepAgent that route across many frontier models in one subscription.
